prompts.name: hero-scene
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: winter Tsukuyomi Space website hero illustration, one wide 16:9 full-bleed image.
Input image 1: user's winter homepage mockup, character/season/style reference only, NOT an interface to reproduce.
Generate a clean anime illustration matching its winter hero artwork: snowy moonlit Japanese lakeside town, snow-covered wooden bridge and rooftops, snow-laden plum branches with small red blossoms, large silvery moon, quiet snowfall, reflected warm lanterns in unfrozen dark water. On the RIGHT half is Tsukimi Yachiyo, silver-white long hair with pink underside, twin looped buns, gold hairpins, delicate reddish eyes, gentle smile. She wears the reference deep navy/crimson/turquoise kimono with a soft white fur-trimmed winter shawl around her shoulders, holds a red paper parasol with a dusting of snow, and offers an open relaxed palm to catch a snowflake. Keep her whole head and hair loops safely inside the frame with at least 4 percent headroom. Three-quarter seated portrait, warm clothing, natural hands and anatomy, recognizable reference identity. LEFT half contains lower-detail snowy lake, roofs and blue mist for CSS overlay text, no painted white panel. Polished high-quality anime rendering, pearl snow, slate/periwinkle blue night, red accents and warm amber lanterns.
No text at all, no signature, Japanese writing, logos, watermarks, navigation, cards, UI, borders or collage. One opaque illustration.

prompts.name: background-light
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: winter light-appearance global website background, single wide 16:9 full-bleed illustration.
Input image 1: user's winter homepage mockup, seasonal style reference. Input image 2: selected winter hero, matching lakeside location and painting style reference.
Generate an EMPTY landscape, absolutely no people. A snow-covered traditional Japanese lakeside village, small bridge, layered distant mountains and pine trees, red-blossom plum branches heavily covered with snow framing the top corners and side edges, silvery full moon, gentle snowfall, warm amber paper lanterns and their soft reflections in a quiet unfrozen lake. Pearl-white snow, luminous pale periwinkle mist and slate blue shadows; low contrast open water and mist through the middle so website overlays stay readable. Delicate high-quality anime illustration consistent with the references. No baked white text panels, no UI, cards, typography, logos, signature, watermarks, borders or collage. Opaque single artwork.

prompts.name: background-dark
prompts.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: winter dark-appearance website landscape background.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the chosen winter light background. Change ONLY exposure, illumination and color grading to a deeper midnight variant. Keep exactly the same lakeside architecture, mountains, plum branches, snow, bridge, moon position, reflections, perspective and empty character-free composition. Deep navy and muted periwinkle shadows, luminous pearl snow edges, subdued moonlit water, restrained amber lanterns. Reduce overall brightness and contrast through the middle for light text and dark cards without making the winter details disappear. Polished anime rendering identical to the source.
No people, no typography, no UI, no logos, watermarks, borders or collage. One opaque wide 16:9 image.

prompts.name: hero-cutout
prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent winter website hero character cutout.
Input image 1 is the selected winter hero, identity and costume reference. Make a separate centered FULL seated figure of the SAME Tsukimi Yachiyo: long silver-white hair with pink underside, twin looped buns, gold hairpins, reddish eyes, friendly face, deep navy/crimson/turquoise winter kimono with white fur-trimmed shawl and sleeve edges, red paper parasol dusted with snow. One relaxed hand gently offering an open palm to catch a snowflake, other hand holds parasol. Entire parasol, all hair loops, long flowing hair, kimono hem and both feet must be fully inside the frame. Zoom OUT enough to leave at least 10 percent fully transparent margin around all extreme edges; the parasol must NOT touch or be clipped by the top or side. Seated on an invisible support, natural correct anatomy, fully covered winter kimono legs. Polished high-quality anime illustration consistent with the reference.
Real alpha transparency everywhere outside the character and parasol; no checkerboard painted in, no background, scenery, floor, drop shadow, snow particles away from figure, text, logo, watermark or border. One character, one transparent asset.
prompts.refinement:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent winter Yachiyo cutout framing correction.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the character, face, pose, kimono, fur, hair, umbrella and artwork exactly. Change ONLY framing: shrink the ENTIRE figure-plus-parasol to occupy at most 78 percent of canvas width and 78 percent of canvas height, centered on a larger transparent square canvas. Expand transparent padding on all four sides. Restore the small top tip of parasol that was clipped. No part of umbrella, hair, kimono or feet may touch ANY edge. At least 10 percent truly transparent padding above the umbrella, below the feet, and left and right of hair. Full-body seated character, no scene or floor, real alpha transparency, no shadow or text. Keep all identity and outfit details from the source.

prompts.name: article-cover
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: winter website default article cover, one wide 16:9 illustration.
Input image 1: selected winter hero as character identity, costume and rendering reference.
Tsukimi Yachiyo sitting on a snow-covered lakeside veranda at night, silver-white long hair with pink underside, twin looped buns, gold hairpins and warm reddish eyes, deep navy/crimson/turquoise kimono and soft white fur-trimmed winter shawl. She gently holds a warm ceramic tea cup in both hands, faint steam curling upward, red parasol resting behind her. Snowy plum branches with tiny red blossoms, a silver moon and soft amber lantern light in the distance, blue snow and warm highlights. Comfortable calm winter feeling, polished anime illustration matching the source, face large enough for a small website thumbnail. Full head including both loops safely inside the frame. Fully covered winter kimono, correct natural hands.
No text, writing, logos, watermark, UI, border or collage. One opaque cover.

prompts.name: pixel-workshop
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: winter pixel workshop website preview cover, one wide 16:9 raster illustration.
Input image 1: winter lakeside background, location and palette reference only.
Crisp intentional PIXEL ART, a small warm wooden lakeside cottage and bridge covered in pearl-white snow, dark blue lake reflecting amber windows and lanterns, distant slate-blue mountains and snowy pines, a silvery full moon, red-blossom plum branches laden with snow along the corner. Strong readable block clusters and stepped silhouettes, restrained retro game palette of navy, periwinkle, pale ice blue, white, warm amber and a little red. Cozy winter midnight scene, clear thumbnail composition. No people, no UI, text, writing, logos, watermark, border or collage. Do not fake an editable canvas; single opaque image.
